theorem.domain: Connected component Q exactly equal to a literal K_{2,2,2} on six vertices with exact lists L(v) subseteq [4].
theorem.algorithm: Exhaustively enumerate all 4^6=4096 color assignments, retain exactly the list-respecting proper assignments.
theorem.colorable_iff: At least one retained assignment exists.
theorem.complexity: O(4^6 * |E(Q)|), a constant with respect to ambient input size.
